pairs.question: Nam quid in oppressu valido durabit eorum, ut mortem effugiat, leti sub dentibus ipsis? ignis an umor an aura? quid horum? sanguen an ossa?
pairs.answer: Nil, ut opinor, ubi ex aequo res funditus omnis tam mortalis erit quam quae manifesta videmus ex oculis nostris aliqua vi victa perire.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question against Anaxagoras' homoeomeria: which of the elemental substances (fire, water, air, blood, bones) could endure to escape destruction. The interrogative spans 851-853 (quid... durabit eorum... ignis an umor an aura? quid horum? sanguen an ossa?) and is directly answered at 854 by 'nil, ut opinor' (none, I think), with the explanatory ubi-clause completing the sentence through 'perire' (856). Answer window ends at the first full stop (perire.); the next line begins a new argument 'at neque reccidere ad nihilum res posse...'. No scaffolding (section markers, verse numbers, footer) falls within the quoted spans; first word of answer capitalized.
